nodes.text: You must be the new warden. Ironhold holds because ordinary folk refuse to kneel — will you stand with us?

options.text: Tell me how I can help.
What work remains for a warden?
I need a moment to look around.

nodes.text: Cinder hares swarm the barley terraces, and boars follow after. Start with the hares — five of them — then we will talk of boars.

options.text: I accept. I will cull the hares.
That sounds dangerous. Farewell for now.

nodes.text: The palisade log never empties: wisps in the fen, crows on the racks, wolves on the road. Take what you can handle — the council notes every name.

options.text: I will take the next task.
Not yet.

nodes.text: The ember keeps you, warden. Come back when the fields breathe easy.
Pell Bryn, scout and scavenger. I buy pelts, fangs and feathers — coin for whatever the wilds throw at you.

options.text: What prowls beyond the palisade?
Any paid work?
Just passing through.

nodes.text: Hares and crows near the fields, boars and wisps deeper in the fen, and rustjaw wolves where the old road crumbles. Watch the tree line.

options.text: Thanks for the warning.

nodes.text: Always something with teeth, friend. Wolves on the road, boars in the barley, hares everywhere. Coin and tonics for proof — take your pick.

options.text: I will take the job.
Maybe later.

nodes.text: Coin for pelts, news for friends. Either is welcome.
So Maren still finds wardens worth sending. I am Sella, and this ridge is my charge — hounds below, sparks above. Will you stand the watch with me?

options.text: Tell me how I can help.
What threatens the ridge?
I need a moment to look around.

nodes.text: Fen hounds den along the ridge trail and grow bold. Drive off four of them, and we will speak of boars and worse.

options.text: I accept. The ridge will be safe.
That sounds dangerous. Farewell for now.

nodes.text: The cairn log never empties: hounds on the trail, boars at the cairns, wisps in the scars, crows on the cords. And beyond them all, the Alpha Prime — the true master of the ridge. Take what you can handle.

options.text: I will take the next task.
Not yet.

nodes.text: The ridge keeps you, warden. Come back with good news.
